title: PreCheck

path.description: A script's path relative to the environment's scripts directory; it must stay inside that directory once links are followed, which the environment checks at each firing.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the script may run before its process tree is killed, 1 to 600 seconds.

oneOf.description: A script in the environment's scripts directory, run with no arguments; its standard output is the pre-check's output.

url.description: The URL fetched with a GET; its body is the pre-check's output.

oneOf.description: A URL fetched with a GET, up to five redirects; a status other than 2xx is a failure.

description: What a routine runs before each firing, whose unchanged output skips the model: a script in the scripts directory, or a URL.
